# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 27 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Sinaiticus (ch 1-31) / P.Mich. 130 (ch 32+), Shepherd of Hermas 27 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_027_page_001.jpg

---

## Mandate 2 — Simplicity and Giving

**1** He said to me, "Keep simplicity and be innocent, and you will be like little children who have no knowledge of the wickedness that destroys human life. **2** First, speak evil of no one, and do not listen with pleasure when someone speaks evil of another. If you do listen, you become a participant in the sin of the slanderer, even if you yourself are blameless — you are guilty simply by taking pleasure in hearing it. **3** Slander no one; speak well of all men. Affirm the good in all — do not add to their sins or diminish their good qualities." **4** "Moreover, do not be reluctant in giving, and when you give, do not grumble; for you will come to know who is the good Rewarder of your generosity. **5** Give to all who are in need without discriminating between those who deserve and those who do not. Give to all, for it is God's will that gifts be given to all from his own blessings. Those who receive will render an account to God for why and how they received; for those who receive in genuine need will not be condemned, but those who receive by hypocrisy will be penalized. **6** The giver, however, is innocent; for just as he received from the Lord a command to give to all, so he must fulfill this service blamelessly. **7** Practice this simplicity, therefore, and you will live to God; and all who practice it will live to God."

---

*LOGOS note: The instruction "give to all without discrimination" is a radical generosity ethic. The responsibility for appropriate reception lies entirely with the recipient; the giver is always innocent if their heart is right.*
